beats_reference: Every selected instance gap is at least its same-instance reference gap, with exact ties accepted and no numerical non-inferiority band.

metrics.name: gap
metrics.means: OPT - max(POP,DP) from independent path-form LP replay
metrics.tolerance: No numerical non-inferiority band: candidate >= reference exactly; the separate 1e-7 matrix/flow validity tolerance is unchanged.

solver_feedback.name: mean_gap
solver_feedback.means: candidate arithmetic mean gap on the public train suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no: an absolute candidate mean, without reference values or per-instance identities.

solver_feedback.name: instance_count
solver_feedback.means: number of independently evaluated public train cases
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no: only the number of evaluated public train instances, without identities or reference values.

progress_feedback.name: beat_spec_progress
progress_feedback.means: aggregate passed and failed gap comparison counts
progress_feedback.reveals_reference: no: aggregate comparison counts and percentages only, without per-instance decisions or reference values.

unit: One selected instance, comparing the independently replayed candidate gap with its same-instance reference gap.
statement_sentences: PASS requires candidate gap >= same-instance reference gap for every selected instance. Exact ties pass with no comparison tolerance; train covers the original public15 and final freshly evaluates public15 plus hidden15.
